use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
const NS: &str = "https://github.com/kiegroup/drools/kie-dmn/_A4BCA8B8-CF08-433F-93B2-A2598F19ECFF";
fn number(text: &str) -> Value {
    let parts: Vec<_> = text.split('.').collect();
    let digits = parts.concat();
    let coefficient = digits.trim_start_matches('0');
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: if coefficient.is_empty() {
            "0".into()
        } else {
            coefficient.into()
        },
        scale: parts.get(1).map_or(0, |s| s.len() as i32),
    }
}
fn record(fields: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'static str, Value)>) -> Value {
    Value::Record(fields.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.into(), v)).collect())
}
fn encode(value: &Value) -> String {
    match value {
        Value::Null => "N".into(),
        Value::Text(text) => format!("S{text}"),
        Value::Number { coefficient, scale } => format!("D{coefficient},{scale}"),
        Value::Record(fields) => format!(
            "R{}",
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}:{}", encode(v)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("|")
        ),
        _ => panic!("unexpected traffic result"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn full_traffic_violation_matches_java_boundaries_and_domain_errors() {
    let mut count = 0;
    let mut errors = 0;
    for line in include_str!("traffic_violation_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let c: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        let scenario: usize = c[3].parse().unwrap();
        let kind = match c[0] {
            "0" => Value::Text("speed".into()),
            "1" => Value::Text("parking".into()),
            "2" => Value::Text("driving under the influence".into()),
            "3" => Value::Text("other".into()),
            _ => Value::Null,
        };
        let actual = match c[1] {
            "-1" => "49",
            "0" => "50",
            "9.999" => "59.999",
            "10" => "60",
            "29.999" => "79.999",
            "30" => "80",
            "30.001" => "80.001",
            _ => panic!(),
        };
        let driver = if scenario == 1 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            record([
                ("Name", Value::Text("Example".into())),
                ("Age", number("40")),
                ("State", Value::Text("Example".into())),
                ("City", Value::Text("Example".into())),
                (
                    "Points",
                    if c[2] == "null" || scenario == 6 {
                        Value::Null
                    } else {
                        number(c[2])
                    },
                ),
            ])
        };
        let violation = if scenario == 2 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            record([
                ("Code", Value::Text("example".into())),
                (
                    "Date",
                    if scenario == 3 {
                        Value::Null
                    } else {
                        Value::Date {
                            year: 2024,
                            month: 1,
                            day: 1,
                        }
                    },
                ),
                ("Type", kind),
                (
                    "SpeedLimit",
                    if scenario == 5 {
                        Value::Null
                    } else {
                        number("50")
                    },
                ),
                (
                    "ActualSpeed",
                    if scenario == 4 {
                        Value::Null
                    } else {
                        number(actual)
                    },
                ),
            ])
        };
        let result = evaluate(&BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "_1F9350D7-146D-46F1-85D8-15B5B68AF22A"), driver),
            ((NS, "_1929CBD5-40E0-442D-B909-49CEDE0101DC"), violation),
        ]));
        if c[4] == "ERROR" {
            assert_eq!(result, Err("field constraint violated"), "{line}");
            errors += 1;
        } else {
            let result = result.unwrap();
            let actual = format!(
                "fine={};suspend={}",
                encode(&result[&(NS, "_4055D956-1C47-479C-B3F4-BAEB61F1C929")]),
                encode(&result[&(NS, "_8A408366-D8E9-4626-ABF3-5F69AA01F880")])
            );
            assert_eq!(actual, c[4], "{line}");
        }
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 321);
    assert_eq!(errors, 126);
}
